name: joomlashack/shackinstaller
description: Shared library for Joomlashack extension install scripts

scripts-descriptions.test: Install test dependencies into tests/vendor and run the Codeception suite
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan static analysis on src against a Joomla checkout, for php 7.4 through 8.5
scripts-descriptions.check: Run analyse and test, stopping at the first failure
